headline: TALK ME DOWN lets you pull the battery now
lede: The bomb's back plate stopped being a read-out and became a workbench: one press pulls a battery into your hand, the round-5 rule spends the act, and the printed page's number is whatever is actually left on the plate — text and truth move together through the trick.

notes.text: THE DRAIN (#1909): edge-triggered pull/push on the flipped panel (no held-key ratchet), IN-HAND pocket, D6 pull-first stamp at round 5 with a named premature-SET strike, live count shifts D5/G5, pocket state rides hash + net snapshot. bombcheck 88/0, tmdlinkcheck 56/0, watchcheck 216/216, mutant killed.

The warden's TARGET was another lane's live issue (slot b was 13 min into #1911 with PR #1913). Step 1b outranks TARGET: resumed the lane's own corpse #1909 instead — freshest checkpoint wins, and a claim attempt on a live lane's issue only forks the liveness namespace.
An inherited "main is red — merge freeze" warning was stale: the failing nightly had been cancelled and the pin it blamed was already fixed at tip. Scripts over warnings: main-ok.sh said go.
